description: Generate complete Laravel REST APIs from a visual builder, your database, a schema or a description, or let Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code generate them through MCP
welcome.installPackage:
The nameless/laravel-api-generator package is not installed in this project yet. It is a dev dependency: it never runs in production and the generated code does not depend on it.
[$(cloud-download) Install the package](command:laravelApiGenerator.installPackage)
Learn more in the [documentation](https://nameless0l.github.io/laravel-api-generator/guide/extension/).
welcome.noEntity:
No generated API in this project yet.
[$(add) New API](command:laravelApiGenerator.generate)
[$(database) Generate from the database](command:laravelApiGenerator.generateFromDatabase)
[$(file-code) Generate from a schema file](command:laravelApiGenerator.generateFromSchema)
Learn more in the [documentation](https://nameless0l.github.io/laravel-api-generator/guide/extension/).
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Laravel API Generator
walkthrough.description: Generate complete REST APIs for Laravel from a form, your database, a schema file, a Mermaid diagram, an OpenAPI spec or a description, or let your coding agent do it.
walkthrough.installPackage.title: Install the Composer package
walkthrough.installPackage.description:
The extension drives the nameless/laravel-api-generator package: 4.x on Laravel 12 and 13, 3.15 on Laravel 10 and 11.
[Install the package](command:laravelApiGenerator.installPackage)
walkthrough.firstApi.title: Generate your first API
walkthrough.firstApi.description:
Describe an entity in the visual form, check the live preview and generate all its files in one click.
[New API](command:laravelApiGenerator.generate)
walkthrough.fromDatabase.title: Import what you already have
walkthrough.fromDatabase.description:
Start from your database, a schema file, a Mermaid diagram, an OpenAPI spec or a description, and review every file before it is written.
[Generate from Database](command:laravelApiGenerator.generateFromDatabase)
walkthrough.exploreSidebar.title: Explore the sidebar
walkthrough.exploreSidebar.description:
Browse generated entities, jump between related files and manage your APIs.
[Show Generated Entities](command:laravelApiGenerator.entities.focus)
walkthrough.agents.title: Let your agent generate
walkthrough.agents.description:
Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code can plan and generate APIs through the package's MCP server.
[Show the Agents block](command:laravelApiGenerator.home.focus)
config.phpPath: Path to the PHP executable. Ignored when phpCommand is set.
config.phpCommand: Full command that runs PHP, one argument per item, for projects where PHP lives in a container. Examples: `["./vendor/bin/sail", "php"]` or `["docker", "compose", "exec", "-T", "app", "php"]`. When empty, `phpPath` is used.
config.mcpEnabled: Offer the package's MCP server to Copilot's agent mode and to Cursor when the project has `laravel/mcp`. It runs `php artisan api-generator:mcp` with the PHP command above.
config.locale: Display language for the Laravel API Generator UI and messages
